steps.code:
# Parse all notes to extract date and habit values
import re

parsed_notes = []
for note in notes_data:
    # Extract date from title: "Habit Tracking Log for YYYY-MM-DD"
    m = re.search(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', note['title'])
    if not m:
        print(f"Warning: no date in title for note {note['note_id']}")
        continue
    date = m.group(1)
    # Parse content lines after the header
    habits = {}
    for line in note['content'].splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if ':' in line and not line.startswith('#'):
            parts = line.split(':', 1)
            habit = parts[0].strip()
            value = parts[1].strip().lower()
            if value not in ('yes', 'no'):
                print(f"Warning: unexpected value '{value}' for habit {habit} in note {note['note_id']}")
            habits[habit] = value
    parsed_notes.append({'date': date, 'habits': habits})

# Check all notes have same habit set and order
habit_order = None
for pn in parsed_notes:
    habits = pn['habits']
    if habit_order is None:
        habit_order = list(habits.keys())
    else:
        if list(habits.keys()) != habit_order:
            print(f"Warning: habit order mismatch in note {pn['date']}")
            print("Expected:", habit_order)
            print("Got:", list(habits.keys()))

print(f"Parsed {len(parsed_notes)} notes")
print("Habit order:", habit_order)
print("First note:", parsed_notes[0])

import csv
import io

# Sort parsed_notes by date
sorted_notes = sorted(parsed_notes, key=lambda x: x['date'])

# Create CSV in memory
output = io.StringIO()
writer = csv.writer(output)
# Header
header = ['date'] + habit_order
writer.writerow(header)
# Rows
for note in sorted_notes:
    row = [note['date']] + [note['habits'][h] for h in habit_order]
    writer.writerow(row)

csv_content = output.getvalue()
